title: dedicated capacity weekly prep - 1:1 notes
content:
Meeting: Dedicated capacity weekly prep (1:1)
Date: 2026-03-02 (prep notes)
Attendees (for reference): Riley (me), Ava (capacity ops), Samir (finance), Joan (SRE)

Purpose / goals for this 1:1
- Align on GPU pool forecast for next 90 days and near-term reservations we should lock in.
- Confirm autoscaling cooldown/policy changes proposal before sending to release staging.
- Surface any capacity risk (regions, H100 availability) and mitigation options.
- Capture follow-ups and owners.

Quick summary / status
- Current committed Dedicated capacity: 280 GPUs (mix of A100-80GB and H100-80GB), across us-west1, eu-west1.
- Recent 2-week trend: steady +6% q/q week-over-week peak utilization (workload ramping from two new customers).
- Peak-day tail (top 1%) is growing due to batch inference jobs from customer X; p95 token throughput increasing; highest concurrency spikes around 11:00-14:00 PT.
- Active reservations to consider: upcoming marketing lift in mid-April (customer-driven) -> projected incremental need ~40 H100-equivalent GPUs for 3 weeks.

Agenda items / talking points
1) Forecast update (Ava)
   - Show 90-day forecast (baseline + committed + optional burst). I want to understand the delta between forecast and commit windows.
   - Discuss whether to convert optional burst to reserved to get cost predictability.
2) Reservation cadence / lead times
   - H100 procurement lead time and cloud provider reservation windows. Who owns the purchase/commit? (Finance vs Capacity Ops)
   - Proposal: convert 20 H100-eq to reserved for Apr-May window; test incremental scaling using dedicated burst.
3) Autoscaling policy tweaks (Samir / SRE)
   - Current: scale-up threshold at 80% pool utilization sustained 5m; scale-down cooldown 15m.
   - Proposal: reduce scale-up sustained window to 2m for on-demand burst pools to reduce 95th percentile latency spikes. Risk: potential oscillation and cost.
   - Consider adding a fast-path for critical low-latency customers (pin to hot-slot pool).
4) Region balancing & migration risk (Joan)
   - eu-west1 H100 capacity low for June–July. Plan: reserve a small buffer in eu-west1 now (10 GPUs) and enable cross-region fallback if necessary.
5) Cost implications (Samir / Finance)
   - Run incremental cost model for converting optional burst to reserved vs on-demand billed. Need monthly cost delta and breakeven point.
6) Follow-ups and data needs
   - Get refined day-by-day demand curve for customer X (Ava).
   - Run sim of autoscaling change (2m sustained) on historical traffic to estimate extra spin-ups/cost (Joan + infra perf team).
   - Finance to model reserved vs on-demand for 20-40 H100-eq (Samir).

Notes to self / talking bullets
- Emphasize reliability: don't over-optimize for cost if it increases p95 latency for paying low-latency customers.
- Clarify definitions: "H100-equivalent" normalization we use (vCPU/FP throughput based) — double-check with infra calc.
- Remind manager that Dedicated SLA includes latency SLOs; any policy change must pass canary tests.
- Flag: billing/pricing change timelines (provider invoice cycles) may mean reservations must be finalized by 2026-03-15 for Apr starts.

Open questions / risks
- If we reduce scale-up sustained window to 2m, do we have telemetry to detect oscillation within 24h? (need dashboards)
- Procurement: if we commit reserved capacity and WAF customer doesn't hit usage, can we re-sell / reassign? What penalties?
- Cross-region fallback: what is expected latency regression for eu->us fallback? Need numbers and cutoff policy.

Data / dashboards to pull before meeting
- 90-day weekly forecast per-region, per-model family.
- Hist: pool utilization (per minute), scale events, and latency (p50/p95/p99) correlated with scale events.
- Reservation lead-time calendar for providers (deadline dates).
- Customer X job schedule (time-of-day distribution).

Draft action items (owner / ETA)
- Ava: provide updated 90-day forecast and customer X day-by-day curve. ETA: 2026-03-04
- Joan + infra-perf: run autoscale 2m sustained simulation on last-90-day traffic; produce cost vs latency impact. ETA: 2026-03-06
- Samir: cost model for reserving 20 vs 40 H100-eq for Apr-May window; include breakeven and cashflow impact. ETA: 2026-03-05
- Riley (me): draft reservation proposal email for leadership with recommended numbers and rationale. ETA: 2026-03-07
- All: decision deadline for Apr reservations: 2026-03-15 (internal commit to providers by 2026-03-18)

Follow-up notes (post-meeting placeholders)
- If Ava's forecast shows >35 GPU delta for Apr, escalate to leadership for fast-track procurement.
- If autoscale sim shows <2% cost increase but reduces p95 by >15ms, push change to canary next week.

Quick checklist before 1:1
- Attach latest forecast CSV and screenshots of utilization graphs.
- Include link to current reservation terms & provider deadlines.
- Confirm who signs off on bill commits (Finance head or COO?) — call out in email.

Scratch ideas / low-effort mitigations
- Short-term: enable a small hot-slot pool (10 GPUs) that is never autoscaled down below 10 for key low-latency customers.
- Medium-term: introduce predictive pre-warm for scheduled large batch jobs (customers can flag jobs to pre-warm).
- Longer-term: introduce fractional reservations (if provider supports) to smooth cost.

Tone notes for manager
- Keep the ask simple: recommend 20-40 H100-eq for Apr; show cost/benefit; propose canary autoscale tweak.
- Present risks and mitigation up-front.

End of notes.

(Internal scratchpad — informal. Will tidy if we need to circulate.)
